turns.question: Of the people who applied to work here between 25 September and 2 October 2026, what share were still in the running at the end of 4 October?
turns.answer: Of the 6 candidates who applied from 25 September to 2 October 2026 (Applications), 2 were still in the running at the end of 4 October 2026 (Candidates in stage: 1 in screen and 1 in interview; the other 4 were 2 hired and 2 rejected), so 2 of 6. The semantic layer has no share metric, so I give the two counts rather than a percentage. Late: recruitment.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
